description:
List analyses for the given repository, newest first.

``repository_id`` is the GitHub ``owner/repo`` (a repo UUID also
works). Mirrors the BranchView's per-branch state. ``commit_sha`` is
the commit the analysis was refreshed against.

For the common 'fix everything wrong on a branch' workflow, prefer
``fix_branch`` — it resolves the latest analysis for you.
name: list_analyses
